title: Testing a 3D workflow for a Sims-like room asset
author: Top-Fee-8522
selftext: I play a lot of life-sim games, and I’ve always liked building interiors more than actually finishing the gameplay part.

comments.author: Brewgazer
comments.body: What’s your main agent you use for coding?

comments.author: Top-Fee-8522
comments.body: For anyone asking about the tool, I’m actually testing Hi3D 3.0 for this workflow. They’re currently doing a 48-hour free event, and you can generate up to 20 models for free, so it’s been pretty convenient for experimenting with different room assets and props.
